newsitem.title: USA: Dynatech sets DynaStar product line sale.
newsitem.headline: Dynatech sets DynaStar product line sale.

text.p: Dynatech Corp said Wednesday it agreed to sell its DynaStar product line, business and assets to ACT Networks Inc, a Camarillo, California-based provider of integrated wide area network access products, for undisclosed terms.
DynaStar is a line of multi-protocol data communications routers and remote access switches developed by Dynatech Communications Inc of Woodbridge, Va., a subsidiary of Dynatech Corporation.
The remaining business of Dynatech Communications will be sold separately, the company said.

With the sale of the DynaStar line, Dynatech is approaching the completion of its program to divest businesses which are non-strategic to its core focus. This program is expected to be completed by the end of the company's fiscal year in March, it added.
